title: After a background gate launch, every later Bash command of the Claude holder is placed in the gate's worktree and refuses its credit
outcome: A Claude session that launches the full gate in the documented background form, `pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`, keeps its shell where it was in the host's model, so a later command it runs in another worktree does not fence the carried gate, while a command it runs in DIR still does.
acceptance: A foreground `pushd "DIR" && COMMAND` that succeeds still moves the shell as today; a test pins it.

A test launches the gate in the background one-call form from a Claude session whose shell is in another worktree, then reports a writing command with no pushd prefix: the carried check is not fenced and the session's shell directory is still the earlier one.
A test shows the same launch followed by a writing command in the form `pushd "DIR" && …` naming the gate's worktree still fences the carried check.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input; a note cites the launcher run and the credited check recorded on w-a450af06e8bd for the same commit.
docs/test.md and docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md say where a Claude session's later commands are placed after a background launch.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 batch 10f6b1ad, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE.
